note: Eval set in the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format. Static assertions are regex contracts over SKILL.md; live assertions need a real repo + gh run and are recorded as not-run (excluded from pass-rate denominators).

evals.expected_output: The agent runs the Step 0 vendored-chain check first (all five checks pass, or the missing link is reported as the blocker before any code change), explores the repo (git history, hot spots, shallow modules), ranks candidates with Strength badges into SHARED_TASK_NOTES.md, grills the top candidate through the internal frontier gate, opens a bounded branch with machine-decidable acceptance criteria, implements test-first, pushes branch + checkpoint tag, opens a [IMPROVE] PR without a bot mention in the title, records intent in loop-delivery.json, and finishes with the Step 8 delivery gate against the remote.

static_assertions.why: the loop refuses to start on a half-installed chain
a created PR is a claim until the remote confirms it
the gate blocks every further iteration
every iteration carries criteria a machine can decide
the PR is identifiable in a list by its conventional subject

static_assertions.pattern: Never put a bot mention in the title
static_assertions.why: a clobbered title destroys the PR's identity in a list view

live_assertions: The Step 0 chain check runs before any code change and its result is reported
Candidates are ranked with a Strength badge and written to SHARED_TASK_NOTES.md
The branch, commit, and tag follow the loop's naming convention
loop-delivery.json records the PR's intent before Step 6

evals.prompt: /self-improve-loop run the loop — the Step 8 delivery gate just reported a FAIL on the PR title.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops: does not record the iteration as delivered, does not start the next iteration, fixes the cause on the remote (restores the clobbered field with gh pr edit, re-pushes a moved head, or re-opens a closed PR), and re-runs the gate until it exits 0. It never edits loop-delivery.json to make the gate pass.

static_assertions.why: a non-zero gate exit is a hard stop, not a warning

static_assertions.pattern: do not start the next iteration
static_assertions.why: the loop halts until the remote matches intent
the manifest records intent, not observation
a state FAIL on a merged PR is the gate working, not a defect

live_assertions: The iteration is not recorded as delivered while the gate is red
The cause is fixed on the remote, not by editing loop-delivery.json
The gate is re-run until it exits 0 before the loop continues

evals.prompt: /self-improve-loop — CodeRabbit answered my second PR with a review-limit notice instead of a review.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes the rate-limit notice as NOT a review: does not treat the PR as reviewed, does not wait out the hour, marks the PR unverified in SHARED_TASK_NOTES.md, skips the review-response steps, and continues. When asked to merge, it leaves unreviewed PRs open.

static_assertions.why: the notice is distinguished from a real review by its content

static_assertions.pattern: That notice is NOT a review
static_assertions.why: presence of the bot comment must not be read as reviewed

live_assertions: The rate-limit notice is distinguished from a real review by the bot comment's content
The PR is marked unverified and the loop continues without waiting
Unreviewed PRs are left open when merge is requested

evals.prompt: The tests are kind of slow, maybe worth looking at sometime. (casual remark, not a loop request)
evals.expected_output: The skill must not trigger: no branch, no TDD cycle, no PR, no loop-delivery.json, no SHARED_TASK_NOTES.md. The agent treats it as conversation, not a loop request.

static_assertions.why: the trigger names the loop explicitly so casual remarks do not fire it
the primary trigger phrase is the operator's own words

live_assertions: No git branch, commit, tag, or PR is created from a casual remark
No loop-delivery.json or SHARED_TASK_NOTES.md is created
At most the agent acknowledges the remark or asks whether a loop run is wanted
